title: Город Валоран
description: The story centers on Lux, a young woman from a wealthy family who escapes the control of her older brother, Garen; she becomes roommates with Jinx, Veigar, and Ezreal in the town of Valoran, leading to a series of hilarious everyday moments of shared living.
